images.prompt: Wide, slightly elevated view across a large modern enclosed football stadium a few hours before a televised match. Steep, empty stands in dark neutral seats, a translucent roof carried by a steel truss structure, a perfectly striped green pitch. On the main stand in the foreground a broadcast camera platform with a camera on a tripod, thin black cables running neatly along the railing. Calm, dusky light, low contrast in the shadows so that text can be placed over the image. The roof is closed all around; no city skyline, no high-rise buildings visible. Typical German Bundesliga-style stadium atmosphere.

Studio floor of a large live entertainment television show. A camera operator, seen from behind, works a studio camera on a pedestal with a large box lens. Behind him a cable assistant, also seen from behind and slightly crouched, guides the thick black camera cable, which lies in tidy figure-eight loops on the glossy dark floor. Magenta and violet stage lighting, soft haze, an out-of-focus LED wall producing bokeh in the background.

Interview position on a red carpet at an evening premiere. A professional broadcast camera on a tripod with a small LED panel light, a sound assistant holding a boom microphone over the scene, a presenter seen from behind holding a handheld microphone, a small field monitor on a stand showing an abstract out-of-focus image. Red carpet, plain blurred backdrop wall without any logos, warm evening light mixed with cool camera light.

Pitch side of a large football stadium during broadcast set-up. Several broadcast cameras on tripods with long telephoto lenses, black flight cases and a stagebox on the ground, cables neatly routed along the edge of the pitch. Two technicians in black work clothes seen from behind, empty stands, overcast daylight. Through an open stadium gate in the background, a compound of parked white outside-broadcast trucks.

portraitStyle: Professional corporate headshot for a broadcast-engineering company website. Shot by a professional portrait photographer from about two metres with an 85 mm lens – no selfie look, no wide-angle distortion, no arm's-length perspective. Head and shoulders, centred, eye level, facing the camera, calm confident natural smile. Plain black crew-neck work shirt without any logo or text. Uniform dark charcoal studio background (#1c1f23) with a subtle soft gradient, soft key light from the left, gentle rim light, natural colour, sharp focus on the eyes. No props, no text, no watermark. Same lighting and framing as the other team portraits.

portraits.note: Shoulders turned slightly to the side, head towards the camera, relaxed professional posture.

Serious, professional, calm expression with at most a slight closed-mouth smile; well-groomed beard and hair; upright posture, arms relaxed, not crossed. The reference is low resolution – reconstruct fine, sharp detail without changing his identity.

connectors.prompt: SMPTE 311 hybrid fibre camera cable connector (Lemo-style 3K.93C type): chunky black cylindrical connector with a metal coupling ring and a dust cap on a short steel lanyard, thick black cable.
Two BNC video connectors on thin black coaxial cable: silver bayonet coupling with gold centre pin, black strain-relief boots.
Two shielded RJ45 network plugs on a white Cat6 cable: metal-shielded plugs with gold contacts and white boots.
Male and female 3-pin XLR audio connectors on black cable: nickel-plated metal housings, black strain reliefs, the male showing three pins.
Rectangular black multipin audio connector (Tuchel/Siemens-style multi-pair connector) with two rows of gold-plated pins, on a thick black multicore cable.
Two rugged quad-channel fibre optic connectors (opticalCON QUAD style): black metal housings with a blue inner ring and black rubber dust covers on lanyards, black armoured cable.
